collection.title: SEAT Tarraco 2022 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a SEAT Tarraco 2022 onwards which requires a 25” wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21” for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
